title: Quantifying Self-Preservation Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks AI alignment by examining 'self-preservation bias' through the lens of instrumental convergence. It specifically evaluates models using ethical/moral frameworks such as utilitarianism (comparing 'company utility' against 'personal interests') and explicitly tests directives for 'selfless' behavior and 'self-sacrifice', which are core components of value alignment and machine ethics.
